extension.description:
Welcome to Jellyfin for Kodi! A whole new way to manage and view your media library. The Jellyfin addon for Kodi combines the best of Kodi - ultra smooth navigation, beautiful UIs and playback of any file under the sun, and Jellyfin - the most powerful fully open source multi-client media metadata indexer and server.
Jellyfin for Kodi is the absolute best way to enjoy the incredible Kodi playback engine combined with the power of Jellyfin's centralized database. Features: * Direct integration with the Kodi library for native Kodi speed * Instant synchronization with the Jellyfin server * Full support for Movie, TV and Music collections * Jellyfin Server direct stream and transcoding support - use Kodi when you are away from home!

extension.summary: Per frame video metadata for CoreELEC 22.
extension.description: Reads the raw video metadata CoreELEC 22 publishes frame by frame during playback. Addons get it as a plain dict, skins get it as Home window properties. Stock Kodi does not publish the metadata, so CoreELEC 22 is required.
extension.news: v1.6.0: publishes the composer data_mapping (reshaping curves and NLQ dequantization) with an include_mapping opt-out, plus the remaining header and block scalars. Every field libdovi decodes is now published. v1.5.0: publishes the rest of libdovi's RPU metadata: L8 saturation/hue trim vectors, colorimetry matrices and signal description, L4/L254/L255 blocks, raw L2 target_max_pq and the remaining header fields.

extension.description: Služba Skin Info Service poskytuje vzhledům podrobná metadata a grafiku nad rámec toho, co Kodi standardně zpřístupňuje. Přidává další vlastnosti, například hodnocení z více zdrojů, grafiku, podrobnosti o streamu a informace o obsazení a ději filmů, seriálů, epizod, sbírek filmů, hudebních videoklipů, interpretů a alb; využívá přitom knihovnu i online data. Obsahuje také nástroj pro vyhledání animovaných plakátů GIF a jejich přidání do knihovny.

Skin Info Service provides skins with rich metadata and artwork beyond what Kodi exposes by default. It adds extra properties such as ratings from multiple sources, artwork, stream details, and cast and plot information for movies, TV shows, episodes, sets, music videos, artists, and albums, drawing on both your library and online data. It also includes a tool to find and add animated GIF posters to your library.

Skin Info Service provides skins with rich metadata and artwork beyond what Kodi exposes by default. It adds extra properties such as ratings from multiple sources, artwork, stream details, and cast and plot information for movies, TV shows, episodes, sets, music videos, artists, and albums, drawing on both your library and online data. It also includes a tool to find and add animated GIF posters to your library.

Skin Info Service provee skins con metadata enriquecida y mejor arte de lo que expone Kodi por defecto. Añade propiedades extra como las valoraciones desde distintas fuentes, arte, detalles de la emisión, elenco y argumento de las películas, programas de TV, episodios, sagas, vídeos musicales, intérpretes y álbumes, pintándolo todo en la colección y datos online. Incluye tambien una herramietna para buscar y añadir carteles de GIF animados para la colección.

Skin Info Service fournit des informations supplémentaires telles que les notes, les illustrations et les détails de flux pour les films, les séries, les sagas, les artistes et les albums. Comprend un outil de recherche d'affiches GIF pour trouver et ajouter automatiquement des affiches GIF animées à votre médiathèque.

A Skin Info Service gazdag metaadatokkal és grafikákkal látja el a felszíneket, amelyek túlmutatnak azon, amit a Kodi alapértelmezés szerint megjelenít. Extra tulajdonságokat ad hozzá, például értékeléseket több forrásból, grafikákat, streamelési részleteket, valamint szereplő- és cselekményinformációkat filmekhez, tévéműsorokhoz, epizódokhoz, díszletekhez, videoklipekhez, előadókhoz és albumokhoz, mind a médiatárad, mind az online adatok felhasználásával. Tartalmaz egy eszközt is, amellyel animált GIF-posztereket kereshetsz és adhatsz hozzá a médiatáradhoz.

Skin Info Service fornisce alle skin metadati e artwork avanzati, oltre a quanto Kodi mostra di default. Aggiunge proprietà extra come le valutazioni da più fonti, artwork, dettagli del flusso e informazioni su cast e trama per film, serie TV, episodi, saghe cinematografiche, video musicali, artisti e album, attingendo sia dalla libreria che dai dati online. Include anche uno strumento per trovare e aggiungere poster GIF animati alla libreria.

Skin Info Service dostarcza skórkom bogate metadane i grafikę, wykraczając daleko poza to, co Kodi udostępnia domyślnie. Dodaje dodatkowe właściwości, takie jak oceny z wielu źródeł, grafikę, szczegóły transmisji oraz informacje o obsadzie i fabule filmów, seriali, odcinków, kolekcji filmowych, teledysków, wykonawców i albumów, korzystając zarówno z Twojej biblioteki, jak i danych online. Zawiera również narzędzie do wyszukiwania i dodawania animowanych plakatów GIF do Twojej biblioteki.

Skin Info Service предоставляет обложкам расширенные метаданные и иллюстрации, выходящие за рамки стандартных возможностей Kodi. Он добавляет дополнительные свойства, такие как рейтинги из нескольких источников, иллюстрации, сведения о потоках, а также информацию об актёрах и сюжете для фильмов, сериалов, серий, киноциклов, музыкальных клипов, исполнителей и альбомов, используя как вашу медиатеку, так и данные из интернета. Также включает инструмент для поиска и добавления в медиатеку анимированных постеров в формате GIF.

extension.description: CoreELEC 22/Piers ARM64 only. Keeps the official addon ID, settings and tailnet state. Supports settings XML formats 1-4 and defaults to retaining CoreELEC DNS. Select this repository for updates to retain the fork fixes.
extension.news: 22.0.12.100: Correct addon version ordering against CoreELEC 22.0.12.9. Includes official Tailscale 1.102.4 ARM64, settings XML version 4 support, optional Tailscale DNS disabled by default, and persistent daemon state directory. Preserves existing login and configuration.

11.0.0~beta7 - Replace Artist Slideshow with Skin Info Service artist fanart - Fix TMDb search not opening the info dialog - Fix searches and music video lists for names with &, commas or quotes - Fix missing PVR seek bar edit markers - Fix the music TriPanel user rating flag - Fix webrip case art on the live background - Performance improvements for low-power devices - Translation updates
11.0.0~beta6 - Add saved searches to the PVR breadcrumb - Load only the similar titles the info dialog shows - Fix mouse support for the Skin Shortcuts action buttons - Fix the PVR search details panel fading out late - Translation updates
11.0.0~beta5 - Rework the PVR search window, group manager, and guide search (wip) - Standardize PVR channel, recording, timer, and info panels plus the event log (wip) - Add a recording indicator to the list item overlay - Add a focused scrollbar color setting and standardize scrollbars across views and dialogs (wip) - Add a drop shadow to back panels (wip) - Add 1.00, 1.19, and 1.90 aspect ratio flags - Add new Skin Info Service widgets and swap the Kodi fanart backgrounds for Skin Info Service slideshows - Add a two line layout for Skin Shortcuts pickers - Add a monospace font to the text viewer - Show set actors above movies in the set panel - Full height biography with dimensions moved off the image panel - Hide add-on info while add-on settings is open - Fix texture references failing on case sensitive filesystems - Fix the button for disabling idle shutdown not appearing - Various view, panel, focus, and label fixes - Translation updates
11.0.0~beta1-beta4 - Update for Skin Info Service v2 and Skin Shortcuts v3 - Move video and person info dialogs to Skin Info Service windows with a navigable stack for cast, recommendations, and similar titles - Reorganize home widgets into Skin Info Service and TMDb Helper submenus with new seasonal and TMDb/Trakt discovery widgets - Rework letter jump with plugin-driven lists and music library support - Add music video support to RightList, LowList, and Icons views - Add music video fullscreen info with online data (record label, Last.fm stats) and an online metadata toggle - Add video info runtime for sets and TV shows - Add DTS-ES, DTS 96/24, and DTS Express audio flags, NL:14 certification, and a LaserDisc source icon - Add Danish and German Plex rating syntax and fix the FSK-0 icon - Gate the Seasons-falling-behind action behind a confirmation - Playlist backgrounds now work in submenus - Hide the seekbar while SkipTro is auto-skipping - Scope the reset button to the main menu only - Various widget, view, layout, label, and scrolling fixes - Translation updates
